meta.Zones covered: Flooded planting bed | children's play area | waterlogged ground | lawns & tree belt
meta.Annotated videos: Four MP4 files in this folder, one per clip

headlineFindings: Waterlogging is the defining problem, exactly as recorded on site. Clip 1 shows a planting bed standing under still, algae-tinted water with a water pipe running through it, and Clip 3 shows churned, saturated ground with open puddles across the whole field of view.

Ground cover has failed across the used parts of the park. Bare and dry ground averages 23-30% of frame in the play area, the waterlogged zone and the flooded bed; lawn cover in those three zones runs under 6%.
Cleanliness is poor and worst in the children's play area, where loose ground debris drives the score to about 30/100 - the weakest single figure in the survey.
The children's play area is the worst-condition zone overall. The sand surface is bare and hard-packed, and a piece of play equipment is lying collapsed on the ground rather than standing.
The lawn and tree belt zone is genuinely healthy - about 75% green cover, 25% lawn, and a cleanliness score of 83. Whatever maintenance regime applies there is not reaching the other three zones.
Vehicles were detected inside the park boundary.
Kerb and edging runs are extensive and mostly intact; benches, play and gym equipment were all found and scored, so the built-asset inventory for these zones is usable.

recommendations.Finding: Standing water is lying across a planting bed and over churned open ground in two of the four zones. This matches the site record of waterlogging and over-watering as the park's main problem.
recommendations.Recommended action: Survey and clear the surface drainage across these zones; check the watering schedule for over-watering and inspect the water pipe running through the flooded bed for a leak.

recommendations.Finding: Ground cover has failed across the three used zones - bare and dry ground at 23-30% of frame, lawn under 6%.
recommendations.Recommended action: Reinstate ground cover after drainage is fixed: decompact, regrade to fall away from the beds, then re-turf and establish an watering regime matched to the corrected drainage.

recommendations.Finding: Loose ground debris drives the children's play area to a cleanliness score near 30/100, the worst in the park.
recommendations.Recommended action: Daily housekeeping in the play area; clear leaf fall and waste, and add or reposition bins.

recommendations.Finding: A piece of children's play equipment appears collapsed on the ground in the play-area clip, and the sand surface beneath the equipment is bare and hard-packed.
recommendations.Recommended action: Inspect and make safe immediately - remove or reinstate the fallen unit, and replace the impact-absorbing surface under all play equipment.

recommendations.Finding: Vehicles were detected inside the park boundary.
recommendations.Recommended action: Confirm whether the movements are allowed maintenance access; otherwise enforce vehicle restrictions.

recommendations.Finding: Pathways and kerb runs show wear consistent with the site record of unmaintained pavement.
recommendations.Recommended action: Patch and resurface the worst track segments; reset displaced kerb and edging.

recommendations.Finding: The lawn and tree belt zone is in good condition - roughly 75% green cover and a cleanliness score of 83.
recommendations.Recommended action: Maintain the current regime there and extend the same standard to the other three zones.

recommendations.Finding: Several items recorded on site have no detector class yet: leaking water pipes, weeds near pathways, gazebo, signpost, street lamp, main gate, monuments, dead trees.
recommendations.Recommended action: Confirm which of these matter most for the DDA report and they can be added - most are feasible; the pipe in Clip 1 is a clear, high-contrast target.

recommendations.Finding: No .SRT telemetry accompanied these clips, and this is a single-date capture.
recommendations.Recommended action: Export flight logs with the video to unlock geo-tagging and the issue map; repeat the same flight path later for change detection against this baseline.
